newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks start slightly higher,but trade quiet.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks start slightly higher,but trade quiet.

text.p: Tokyo stocks opened slightly higher on Tuesday but trading remained quiet, brokers said.
"There will probably be no major developments in the stock market today," said Tadahiro Kamogawa, general manager of Yamaichi Securities.
By 0013 GMT, the key 225-issue Nikkei average was 50.80 points or 0.24 percent higher at 20,936.21. Its December futures fell 40 points to 20,930.
Brokers said stocks were likely to remain stuck in narrow ranges as local investors were waiting for the formation of a new Japanese government and the launch of economic policies.
